$/restaurant/name = "Xi'an Famous Foods"
$/restaurant/address = "45 Bayard St, New York, NY 10013"
$/restaurant/rating = "4.6 / 5"

root = Card(cardContent)

cardContent = Column([titleText, addressRow, ratingRow, divider, bookButton], "start", "stretch")

titleText = Text("**Xi'an Famous Foods**")

addressRow = Row([locationIcon, addressText], "start", "center")
locationIcon = Icon("locationOn")
addressText = Text($/restaurant/address, "caption")

ratingRow = Row([starIcon, ratingText], "start", "center")
starIcon = Icon("star")
ratingText = Text("4.6 / 5 (Rating)", "body")

divider = Divider("horizontal")

bookButton = Button(bookButtonText, "primary", Event("book_table", {restaurant: $/restaurant/name}))
bookButtonText = Text("Book a Table")
